THIN BLUE THREAD: a thin blue thread of wood smoke rising perfectly straight through still air and fraying softly at the top
LOW SMOKE LAYER: a low pale layer of wood smoke lying flat across the hollow, settling close to the ground in long slow sheets
RESIN HAZE DRIFTING: a faint resin-scented haze drifting sideways through the air in a slow soft lateral drift
SMOKE OFF THE STONES: thin wisps of wood smoke curling gently off the near stones, rising a little then spreading flat
SMOKE VEIL BETWEEN TREES: a soft translucent veil of smoke hanging between the near and far trees, diffusing everything gently
SMOKE THINNING ABOVE: wood smoke rising and thinning gradually until the air above reads open and almost perfectly clear
KNEE-HIGH GROUND MIST: a dense knee-high white mist lying flat across the meadow, smooth and still on top
MIST ON THE WATER: mist lying on the water in flat unbroken sheets, perfectly level and slow-settling
THIN VALLEY HAZE: a thin pale haze hanging in the valley, softening the far trees to a gentle blur
SEA FOG ROLLING IN: sea fog rolling in slowly and softly across the open ground, thick and low and unhurried
MIST THINNING TO CLEAR: ground mist thinning gradually upward until the air above sits open and clean and still
STILL AND SHARP: air standing perfectly still and sharp and dry, every edge in the near distance reading crisp and clean
CRISP FAR RIDGE: cold dry air so clear and still that the far ridge reads with a hard precise edge
BITING CLEAR COLD: dry biting cold air standing utterly still, so clear that every far edge and every near ridge reads hard and exact
DEAD CALM AND GLASSY: dead-calm air lying glassy and even over the whole ground, holding every far shape in a clean unwavering edge
LIGHT COLD BREEZE: a light cold breeze moving slowly through the grass, bending the blades in long easy waves
SOFT FINE DRIZZLE: a soft fine drizzle hanging in the air in tiny slow-falling drops, thickening the near atmosphere gently
STEADY QUIET RAIN: steady quiet rain falling straight down through still air, each drop small and unhurried
RAIN EASING OFF: rain easing to a stop and leaving the air damp and heavy, everything around glistening and wet
WARM DAMP AIR AFTER RAIN: warm damp air sitting close to the ground after rain, soft and full and quietly heavy
DRY WARM HAZE: a dry warm haze lying across the open ground, blurring the middle distance to a soft pale wash
DUSTY EVENING AIR: fine dust hanging still in warm air, thickening the middle distance to a soft amber wash
AMBER DUST HAZE: a dry amber-tinted haze of fine dust drifting slowly across the warm ground in a low soft band
SAND SKIMMING LOW: a light breeze carrying loose sand in a thin low layer skimming slowly across the open ground
SEED FLUFF DRIFTING: a gentle breeze carrying loose seed fluff drifting low and slow across the ground in soft clusters
